fact: Governor Naji Issa said the project to connect Libya to China's CIPS cross-border payment system has begun, with a pilot phase targeted for early 2027.

Circular 6 of 2026 of the Central Bank of Libya authorises licensed exchange companies to send direct foreign remittances for companies and small traders via a unified platform, with a USD 100,000 per-transfer and USD 300,000 annual ceiling.
system: Direct foreign remittances via exchange companies (unified platform)

fact: The Central Bank of Libya and the People's Bank of China formally agreed that Libyan banks will join China's Cross-Border Interbank Payment System (CIPS), with no start date given.
